music.M1_open: Instrumental only, no vocals. Modern explainer documentary score for a personal-finance channel. Key of F major, 92 BPM. Warm, curious, precise and intelligent, never cheesy or corporate. Palette: soft felt piano, warm analog synth arpeggio, light pizzicato strings, subtle brushed percussion, airy pads. Leaves space for narration. Opening: sense of wonder and scale. A single felt-piano motif over a slow rising pad, gentle arpeggio enters, builds curiosity, ends on a suspended chord.
